# opacity reason

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:opacityReason`](gmeow-opacityReason.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/opacityReason>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Why a frame is opaque to the describing reader (spec §7.6): an encrypt-class codec without a key, a codec the reader lacks, or damage. Functional and REQUIRED (see shapes): opacity without a stated reason is indistinguishable from data loss.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](../classes/gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](../classes/gmeow-OpacityReason.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use whenever a frame is surfaced as opaque — it is required, because a stated reason (missing key, unknown codec, damage) is what distinguishes a deliberately sealed or unreadable frame from silent data loss.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it on any opaque frame and avoid stacking several reasons (it is functional — one reason per reader-frame pair); the reason is relative to the describing reader, not a property of the bytes.

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](../classes/gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md) at exactly one [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](../classes/gmeow-OpacityReason.md); for missing-key opacity, pair it with [`gmeow:sealedRecipient`](gmeow-sealedRecipient.md) to name the agents for whom the frame is not opaque at all.
